items.text: This week, I had the opportunity to meet with mayors from across the district—from Norwich and New Berlin to Hudson—to discuss local challenges related to housing, infrastructure, and treatment services. I will take these valuable conversations to Congress as we work toward solutions together.

Visited Ellenville Regional Hospital today—a rural lifeline where Medicare & Medicaid patients account for 88% of admissions and 61% of outpatient care. We can't allow cruel and senseless budget cuts to threaten hospitals our families depend on. https://t.co/BwK5B6bd6q

Catholic Charities provides addiction treatment, food assistance, and other critical services to people across the Hudson Valley. Their work saves lives, but extreme budget cuts in Washington would devastate it. I met with them today to hear more and learn how I can help. https://t.co/KdXeGp6UCB

I met with @GarnetHealth leadership in D.C. this week to discuss their Catskills facility. Nearly 90% of their patients come from Sullivan County, where they provide 24/7 emergency and inpatient care. Proud to support their work in #NY19. https://t.co/wLD1RlAhxm

Our local hospitals have seen their costs go up, but the Medicare reimbursements they receive haven’t kept up. Our bill fixes that. 

https://t.co/7M7TQux5wt

Whether it’s for work, school, or staying in touch with family, rural broadband access isn’t a luxury—it’s a necessity. It was great to meet with telecom leaders from across Upstate today to talk about how we can expand coverage and lower costs. https://t.co/gnUanDvxKK

The House Republican plan would tear healthcare away from more than a million New Yorkers.

All to give tax breaks to a bunch of billionaires and big corporations.

It’s cruel, backwards, and everything wrong with Washington.

https://t.co/cWeQqXMwqa

Every student deserves to go through the school day without worrying about where their next meal will come from.

It was great to visit Ithaca’s school nutrition team and the IHS Community Market to see firsthand how they’re tackling food insecurity, from free school meals to take-home groceries.

Hospital closures. Staff shortages. Cuts to rural care.

That’s the reality under the GOP’s so-called health care plan—and it’s going to cost lives.

https://t.co/mbbVpfCAum

20,000 kids in rural Upstate NY just lost school counselors.

Why? Because a bunch of bureaucrats down in Washington decided they don’t deserve it. 

It’s disgusting, and we will do everything we can to fight back.

https://t.co/ixmruoUtzO

Our firefighters run into danger everyday to save lives.

But long after the flames are out, many battle PTSD in silence.

We all must continue fighting to honor our heroes with the mental health support they need, when they need it, close to home.

https://t.co/tblIkzaxq9

The Senate voted to cut Medicaid.

To slash food assistance.

To put rural hospitals one step closer to shutting their doors.

I don't know a single person in Upstate New York who thinks we should balance the budget by taking meals from kids and healthcare from working families.
The first would shield rural hospitals from Medicaid cuts, because your zip code should not determine the quality of care.
The second lowers prescription drug prices for seniors, because no one should have to choose between putting food on the table and the RX medication they need.

The second is the ACES Act, which commissions a study on cancer risks among aircrew Veterans. 

Because any hero facing health risks tied to their service deserves answers.

In May, I requested $2M in federal funding for Refuah Health to build a medical center in Sullivan County.

Today, I was honored to visit the site and discuss our progress. 

Rural health providers are under attack like never before. I won't let Upstate New York fall behind. https://t.co/qgLRjUzAJ3

Operation "Healthy Broome" is up and running!

Our heroes at the Army, Air Force, and Navy are delivering free healthcare services–including child physicals and medical screenings–to Upstate families at the SUNY Broome Ice Center until August 20th. 

Learn more below ⬇️

Every day through August 20th, the Department of Defense and Broome County are offering free medical, dental, and eye care at SUNY Broome.

I had a great time today dropping off Nirchi's pizza and thanking these heroes for serving our community. https://t.co/z762JGkCO9

The GOP’s Big Ugly Bill guts Medicaid, puts hundreds of rural hospitals at risk, and drives doctors & nurses out of Upstate NY. I voted no, called it out on the House floor, and I’m not done—I’ll keep fighting to protect our care.

https://t.co/tYiMg2Vhg9
